categories.name: Most Power
categories.description: The current Power limit of the game. Power ignores substats and the fairy, so those are the ones of the best DPS build with the same weapon kind.

categories.name: DPS Melee
categories.description: The most damage per second with a melee weapon, ranked on the 24 h test against a dummy that cannot die, where the attack animation shows.

categories.name: DPS Ranged
categories.description: The most damage per second with a ranged weapon, ranked on the 24 h test against a dummy that cannot die, where the attack animation shows.

categories.name: HPS Melee
categories.description: The most healing per second (regen, lifesteal, skill heals) with a melee weapon, ranked on the 24 h test.

categories.name: HPS Ranged
categories.description: The most healing per second (regen, lifesteal, skill heals) with a ranged weapon, ranked on the 24 h test.

categories.name: Build Lab
categories.goal: Wins the arena against the other builds
categories.description: Found by the build lab: arena battles (game PvP rules) against the best build of every category, searching animation, pets, fairy and substats. The active skills barely matter there: the battles end before most of them come into play.

categories.name: Main Quest
categories.description: The builds that go furthest in the main quest: the furthest battle cleared (at least 50% wins in the battle simulator, every difficulty in order), searched from where the strongest builds already get.
